primary_identifier.recursive_projection: same frozen Phase-10 18-bit companded token projection after every step

primary_rule: PASS only if the 62-feature token model beats raw-state persistence on all four Burgers tests in all three fresh registered replicates (12/12 cells). Any ratio >=1.0 is Phase-26 FAIL. No retries or replacement seeds.

next_if_pass: A separate preregistered cross-family phase must verify that the richer 62-feature identifier does not regress wave, Gray-Scott, NLS, and advection before calling it a unified upgrade.
